We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 3 reactions using templates 1914393, 1914394, 1914395 in this order.

We have applied 1914393 to target, got two fragments: fragment A = "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1" and fragment B = "FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1". So first reaction splits target into those two.

Now need to apply template 1914394 to each fragment? The order is 1914393 then 1914394 then 1914395. Likely we apply 1914394 to one of the fragments, then 1914395 to resulting fragments.

We attempted applying 1914394 to fragment A but got no result. Apply to fragment B gave result: ("ClCCl", "FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1"). So fragment B further splits into "ClCCl" (dichloromethane?) and "FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1". So second reaction (template 1914394) applied to fragment B yields those two.

Now we need third reaction using template 1914395 on remaining fragments maybe "FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1" or "ClCCl". Let's try apply 1914395 to "FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1".
